settings.about.body: Tatakai Next is free software under the AGPL-3.0-or-later. Fonts are under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. Video playback uses libmpv and FFmpeg (LGPL).
settings.data.hint: Everything lives in the app's data directory on this computer. No telemetry.
settings.about.uptodate: You are on the latest version
settings.data.telemetry_hint: This build sends nothing. No switch because there is nothing to turn off.
settings.system.reset_hint: Deletes settings, history, connected accounts, extensions and caches on this PC. Your AniList / MAL lists are not touched.
settings.system.reset_confirm: Reset Tatakai Next? This cannot be undone.
settings.system.magnet_handler_hint: Registers this app as the magnet: handler for your user account. No installer needed.
setup.title: Welcome to Tatakai Next
setup.intro: A few choices to start. You can change all of them later in Settings.
settings.data.clear_history_body: Removes every watched episode and resume position stored on this PC. Paired phones keep their own copy.
settings.data.clear_history_hint: Continue watching and resume positions start over.
settings.data.metadata_hint: Details, characters and watch order saved from AniList so pages open quickly.
settings.data.sync_hint: The history syncs with your paired phones over Tatakai Link, with the exact position to resume.
settings.data.sync_never: No phone has synced the history yet.
settings.data.sync_no_device: No phone is paired. Pair one in Tatakai Link to continue on your phone where you left off here.
settings.data.sync_now_hint: Status refreshed. Phones sync when they open the app or close the player.
settings.system.autostart_hint: Opens Tatakai when you sign in to your computer.
settings.system.check_updates: Notify about new versions at start-up
settings.system.check_updates_hint: Asks GitHub Releases once per launch and shows a notice. Nothing is downloaded.
settings.system.close_to_tray_hint: The close button hides the window; quit from the tray menu.
settings.system.rerun_setup_hint: Go through the first-run choices again.
settings.system.reset_body: Deletes settings, cache, history, local lists, saved keys and paired Link devices on this PC, then starts like the first time.
settings.system.start_minimized_hint: When the system starts Tatakai, only the tray icon appears.
settings.system.tray_hint: Shows Tatakai in the system tray with Show and Quit.
setup.accounts.hint: Optional. Your lists, progress and favorites live in AniList or MyAnimeList; Tatakai works without an account.
setup.appearance.hint: Pick a language and a look.
setup.done.body: All set. Search a series or open one from Home to start watching.
setup.done.later: Everything can be changed later in Settings.
setup.downloads.folder_hint: Where torrents are saved. Leave it as is to use the default folder.
setup.downloads.hint: Torrent sources download to this folder while you watch.
setup.extensions.hint: Sources come from .kai extensions you install. Tatakai ships none; add the ones you trust.
setup.extensions.later: You can manage extensions later in Extensions.
setup.optional_later: You can set this later in Torrents › Settings.
setup.player.hint: How episodes play and which source Tatakai picks first.
setup.player.later: You can change these later in Settings › Player.
setup.system.discord: Show what you watch on Discord
setup.system.hint: How Tatakai fits into your computer.
update.skipped: This version will not be announced again
